description: This file defines the NodeCapabilityRouter class in Swift, which manages command handling by dispatching requests to appropriate handlers based on command strings. It includes error handling for unknown commands and employs asynchronous handling.

classes.name: NodeCapabilityRouter
classes.description: A class that routes commands to registered handlers asynchronously, with error handling for unknown commands.

classes.name: RouterError
classes.description: An enumeration defining error cases for the router, including unknown commands and unavailable handlers.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes a BridgeInvokeRequest by finding and invoking the appropriate handler asynchronously, throws an error if the command is unknown.
